orderingRule: New reports enter this backlog. Reorder only for an evidenced data-loss, routing, security or unusable-core-path blocker; explain the reason. Finish a coherent verified fix before starting another feature release.

Recent history loads independently of older pagination; preserve read position and local messages
acceptance: Reproduce current stale-session path with timestamped canonical head/history and client observations
Actual native recent-message arrival and disconnect/reopen retain original identities without resubmission
No unseen new answer hidden behind historical pagination

verificationPolicy: Use focused service/native journeys and original receipts. A build or unit count is not proof of phone usability. Do not replay unknown deliveries or wake business workers.

architectureReview.userDirection: Review whole codebase and determine integrated delivery architecture before further isolated fixes
architectureReview.implementationRule: Repository-owned synchronization and shared conversation state/shell; preserve backend authority, original identities and delivery journals; no broad rewrite or production change inferred.
